== The Road to Oz ==

Polychrome is known as the Rainbow's Daughter, one of those who live upon the rainbow among the fleecy clouds. When Dorothy, addressing her as "Polly," asks whether she can perform any magic, Polychrome answers plainly that she cannot, explaining that those who dwell on the rainbow have no use for magic.

During a crossing by boat, Polychrome clings to the bow, watching ahead until she makes out a row of jagged rocks marking the edge of a desert, beyond which lies a tableland of green grass and trees. According to the account of this crossing, she travels alongside Dorothy, the shaggy man, Button-Bright, and Toto, stranded at the edge of the Deadly Desert until a sand-boat is built to carry them across; the boat eventually strikes the rocks at the desert's far edge, though the party lands unharmed in the yellow Country of the Winkies.

=== Events ===

* Dorothy, the shaggy man, Button-Bright, Toto, and Polychrome are stranded at the edge of the Deadly Desert with no way to reach the Land of Oz.
